caveats: Batch is entirely small independent auto repair/tire shops within a few blocks of each other in New Brunswick; eight of ten have no website, so most findings rest on Google Business Profile and directory data.
Google Maps was read in a limited view for several listings (New Brunswick Tire Co., King Auto), so review counts and claim status could not always be captured.
Google's 'Claim this business' prompt was treated as evidence of an unclaimed profile; it is a UI signal and could lag reality.

Phone numbers in batch.json sometimes differed from the live Google listing (e.g. Prestige 732-317-1515 is the second shop; Arnold's and JVH's had no phone in batch.json but publish one). Live listing numbers were used.
Review quotes were paraphrased to a few words; no review text is reproduced at length.
data_gaps: No Google review count captured for New Brunswick Tire Co. and King Auto (limited map view); loc8nearme mirrored about 102 comments for New Brunswick Tire.
Brands, tire lines, warranties and any price ranges are unpublished for all ten businesses; no pricing evidence exists.
Staff counts are unknown for every business; size was inferred from locations, review volume and hours.
Brunswick Collision: no hours anywhere and no dated activity after the 2009 blog; operation is inferred from the live Google listing and reviews.
Spanish-language/bilingual claims could not be verified by phone for Rainey's, Llantas, Brothers, Prestige or Claudio (only Arnold's states it on its site).
No review-platform presence (Yelp/BBB) was opened for most shops beyond what search snippets surfaced.
